correctness.rationale: The causal L² series converges since m2<1 and bounded S(H). Difference coupling decays in L², ensuring uniqueness even among other invariant laws. Conditional stationarity under Gaussian prior is mixture with variance Q(h)=R(h)²v+S(h)²; mixture Gaussian iff Q constant (fourth cumulant 3Var(Q)), which for two different h forces theta=1/2, while singleton steps and midpoint preserve Gaussian exactly. Conditional on step history X is N(0,V) with perpetuity V=S²+R²V'; for q=p/2, Minkowski/subadditivity gives finite E V^q iff E|R|^p<1, and positivity S²>0 rules out >=1 by strict inequality. Exact independent rational reproduction: Euler laws A [(1/2,1/2),(3/2,1/2)] and B [(11/12,36/37),(4,1/37)] both E H=1,E H²=5/4,m2=1/4,v=4/3; A m4=1/16 and fourth moment 92/15; B m4=1261/576>1 hence infinite fourth moment. M_B(3)=1297/1776<1; convexity unique finite-moment cutoff 3<kappa<4. Scope no exact tail asymptotics.
